verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a first-party MCP server that lets external AI agents query traces, logs, and metrics via live Honeycomb data, plus a full REST API and downloadable OpenAPI spec for programmatic access to datasets, queries, triggers, and SLOs, directly enabling agent-driven production debugging. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability/quality (community evidence only discusses manual multi-tool correlation, not the MCP path), and a live-reachable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s on standard paths).
